title: Fix SignalR push log level — Debug to Warning for dashboard push failures
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-WEB-003

All three dashboard push methods in `AgentBackgroundService.cs` log SignalR failures at `LogDebug` instead of `LogWarning`:
- `PushStatusToDashboardAsync`: `logger.LogDebug(ex, "SignalR status push failed (best-effort).");`
- `PushChatToDashboardAsync`: `logger.LogDebug(ex, "SignalR chat push failed (best-effort).");`
- `PushGoalToDashboardAsync`: `logger.LogDebug(ex, "SignalR goal push failed (best-effort).");`

**Impact:** In production, dashboard connectivity failures are invisible unless Debug-level logging is enabled. Violates Rule E-3 (every catch that doesn't rethrow must log at Warning or higher).

**Recommendation:** Change all three to `logger.LogWarning(ex, ...)`. These are non-fatal but important operational signals.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Changed LogDebug to LogWarning for all three SignalR dashboard push failure paths in AgentBackgroundService.cs: PushStatusToDashboardAsync, PushChatToDashboardAsync, PushGoalToDashboardAsync. These are non-fatal but important operational signals that should be visible at default log levels. Validated: dotnet build succeeds, 822 tests pass.
